name: Playa de Quemado
hero_subtitle: Principal playa urbana de Al Hoceima — arena dorada, acceso fácil y cara cotidiana de la bahía.

overview.title: The city’s main beach
overview.p1: Quemado is Al Hoceima’s main urban beach — golden sand, easy town access and the everyday face of the bay.
overview.p2: In season you will find cafés, showers and basic services along the front. It is free and public; loungers from private operators are optional.
overview.p3: Morning is quieter; late afternoon brings softer light. Pair with the port and corniche for a full seafront day.

q1.question: Is Quemado Beach free?
q1.answer: Yes. It is a public urban beach. Loungers or umbrellas from private operators are optional and paid.

q2.question: Best time of day?
q2.answer: Morning for quieter sand; late afternoon for softer light and a cooler swim.

q3.question: Facilities?
q3.answer: In season you will find cafés, showers and basic services along the front.

q4.question: Safe for families?
q4.answer: Generally yes in calm conditions; always watch children near the water.

q5.question: How long to spend?
q5.answer: Two to four hours is typical; full days work if you like urban beach life.
